description: Fires when an app.flowstate.event record arrives from a source this flow listens to. Only localSource is implemented; spaceSource and hubSource are reserved for the designs in docs/design/private-automation-layer.md.

source.description: Where events come from. Open union so new transports can be added without changing the trigger.

event.description: Event name to match. '*' matches any event from the source.

from.description: Optional allowlist of sender DIDs. Space membership already restricts who can write; this narrows it further for one flow.

exposeData.description: Keys of event.data that action templates may read as {{event.data.<key>}}. Anything not listed is invisible to actions. title/body are always available as {{event.title}} / {{event.body}}.

localSource.description: Events emitted on this device by another flow (app.flowstate.action.emitEvent with target 'local'). Needs no network and no account.

spaceSource.description: Events written into an AT Protocol space: a flow's inbox space, a group space, or the owner's personal space.

space.description: Space URI: at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Uses at-uri until the proposed 'space-ref' string format lands.

hubSource.description: Events posted to the user's Flow State hub over plain HTTPS by senders without an AT Protocol identity (Home Assistant, CI, curl). Each sender gets its own revocable token; the token never appears in the flow.

senderId.description: Opaque id of the sender registration on the hub.
